title: Urgent flood relief for Sindh families
rejection_reason: Unverifiable claims; organizer did not respond to verification requests.
body: Our trust has been serving flood-affected families in Sindh for over a decade. Funds will provide tents, clean water and food for 300 families. Every donation is spent directly on relief supplies delivered by our volunteers on the ground.

title: Qurbani 2025 — meat distribution for 400 families
body: Amanah Qurban Services carries out qurbani on your behalf across East Java. Each share feeds one family for several days. Livestock is inspected for health and age before slaughter, and distribution is documented and reported back to donors.

title: Qurbani 2024 — meat distribution for 320 families
body: Amanah Qurban Services carries out qurbani on your behalf across East Java. Livestock is inspected for health and age before slaughter, and distribution is documented and reported back to donors.

title: Borehole repair — Kaduna State
body: Two boreholes serving 900 residents have been out of service since November. This campaign funds pump replacement and a six-month maintenance contract.

title: Ramadan iftar programme 2026
body: Daily iftar for around 250 people through Ramadan, open to all, at the masjid community hall.

title: Emergency surgery for my father
body: My father needs cardiac surgery at Lagos University Teaching Hospital. We have the surgeon's letter and the hospital estimate.

title: School fees for 40 orphaned girls
rejection_reason: Organizer registration revoked following governance audit; funds could not be safeguarded.
body: Annual school fees, uniforms and books for 40 orphaned girls in Mombasa.

title: Winter blankets for Rohingya camps
body: Twelve thousand blankets distributed across four camps in Cox's Bazar ahead of the cold season.

title: Help me finish my nursing degree
body: Final year tuition for my nursing degree in Dakar. Transcripts and enrolment letter attached.

title: Masjid roof repair — Calgary
body: Structural repair to the prayer hall roof after ice damage. Contractor quote and engineer's report on file.

title: Water well for Timbuktu village
body: One deep well serving 600 residents, drilled and handed over to a village maintenance committee.

title: Medical bills after a road accident
body: My brother was hit by a car in Birmingham and needs ongoing physiotherapy not covered by the NHS waiting list.

title: Rebuild our village masjid after the earthquake
body: The masjid in our village was declared unsafe after the February tremors. This campaign funds demolition and rebuild to current seismic code.

title: Orphan sponsorship — 25 children, Peshawar
body: Monthly stipend, schooling and healthcare for 25 orphaned children, reported quarterly to sponsors.
